$comment: Which reference to read for a change (plan WP4). paths_any: globs on changed files; anchors_any: regexes on added or removed lines; always: every change; on_demand: the task decides, the diff cannot. Render the SKILL.md table with node tools/bin/render-routes.ts.

routes.when: The code serves Store-API or headless clients.
The code queries the DAL, checks what a customer can see, runs on a hot path, or dispatches queued work.
The change adds or keeps a class_exists or method_exists check for Shopware API.
The change adds or edits comments or docblocks that talk about earlier versions, removed code or the issue.
anchors_any: ^\s*(//|#|\*|/\*).*\b([Pp]reviously|[Oo]riginally|used to|no longer|[Ee]arlier (version|revision|approach)|[Bb]efore this (change|PR|fix)|this (PR|pull request)|was (changed|replaced|removed) (to|in|with)|instead of the old)\b

routes.when: A fix grows beyond the bug.
